acceptedRegressions.label: wpt-false-pass
acceptedRegressions.reason: pass -> fail vs the pin (shipped main). The OLD pass was false: the pin dropped a U+3000 IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE that starts a line, whatever `hanging-punctuation` says (U+3000 is not collapsible white space, CSS Text 3 4.1), so the down arrow sat at the reference's x without anything hanging. Neither engine supports the property: `hanging-punctuation` is absent from Stylo 0.18.0 (the pin's) and 0.22.0 (beta.4's), so the declaration is dropped in both. A 1 em ideographic space that does not hang is what the spec gives without the property, and Chrome 155 (which does not implement hanging-punctuation) fails the test too. The tip lays out U+3000 with its 40 px advance and the arrow 40 px to the right.
